These 8 stories are the front-page stories for the v2 build; each was checked against live reporting on 2026-11-24 (Reuters/Hypebeast/Inc42 for Huang; AFP via France 24/Shafaqna for the 14 nations acknowledging the ICJ ruling on 24 Nov; USGS/NCS for the Nepal quake on 24 Nov; Reuters for the Gaza strikes on 24 Nov; CNN/WSJ for the Libya strike; Reuters/BBC for COP31; wire summary for the Poland missiles and Indonesia fire). No further items were invented; no market numbers beyond the verified Nvidia +31% and $4.0T are used. v3 additions (2026-11-25): Guterres "deeply disappointed" line in the COP31 story verified against UN News and AP, 23 Nov 2026; Tiangong/Shenzhou-24 story verified against Reuters, 24 Nov 2026 (announcement that day; launch 25 Nov).

body: Nvidia's board voted unanimously on Monday to reinstate its co-founder as president, chief executive and director, effective immediately, 11 days after he resigned on 12 November.
Colette Kress, who served as interim chief executive, returns as chief financial officer.
stories.headline: HUANG IS BACK AT NVIDIA
stories.standfirst: Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia chief executive 11 days after resigning, as shares surge 31% and the chipmaker's market value climbs back to $4.0T.

body: Fourteen countries acknowledged the International Court of Justice ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, urging compliance with the binding decision.
stories.headline: 14 NATIONS BACK ICJ RULING

body: Climate talks in Antalya collapsed on Sunday after the EU and others rejected a final deal as too weak on fossil fuels. UN chief António Guterres called it "deeply disappointing."
stories.headline: CLIMATE TALKS END IN FAILURE

body: Ukrainian sea drones sank the Russian corvette Merkury off Benghazi, Kyiv's first acknowledged strike in Libya. Seven drones were used; a Ka-27 helicopter was destroyed.
stories.headline: UKRAINE SINKS RUSSIAN WARSHIP OFF LIBYA

body: A 5.4 quake hit Nepal on Tuesday; tremors were felt across five countries.
stories.headline: 5.4 QUAKE SHAKES NEPAL

body: Israeli strikes killed at least six in Gaza on Tuesday, medics said, despite the ceasefire.
stories.headline: ISRAELI STRIKES KILL SIX IN GAZA

body: NATO sends AWACS aircraft to Poland after three Russian-made missiles crossed its airspace.
stories.headline: AWACS TO POLAND

body: A factory fire in Indonesia kills 24 people, with about 30 still unaccounted for.
stories.headline: ASIA FACTORY FIRE KILLS 24

body: China said on Tuesday that Pakistani pilot Muhammad Zeeshan Ali will become the first foreign national aboard its Tiangong space station, launching on Shenzhou-24 on Wednesday with Tang Hongbo and Wu Yi.
stories.headline: FIRST FOREIGNER BOUND FOR TIANGONG
